name: credit-meter
description: ElevenLabs characters and Higgsfield credits at a glance, with a heads-up before a tool call spends them

elevenlabs_api_key.title: ElevenLabs API key
elevenlabs_api_key.description: Optional. Leave empty to use the ELEVENLABS_API_KEY environment variable, or the key your ElevenLabs MCP server is configured with in ~/.claude.json.

higgsfield_server.title: Higgsfield MCP server
higgsfield_server.description: The name of your Higgsfield MCP server or connector, as /mcp lists it. The mod also tries "higgsfield".
